passives.name: Flames of Combat
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken effect to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). After using Ballad of a Soldier / Apocalypse Now, when a target hit is not inflicted with Burned, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_2], and inflicts an irremovable Burned on a random ally for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000073_4_3] turn(s).
